name: London Food Bank
description: Free groceries for individuals and families. Saturday mornings are reserved for college and university students.
eligibility: Anyone in need. Bring photo ID for each family member at every visit (students: a student card).
hours: Mon–Fri 9 am–4 pm; Sat 9–11 am (post-secondary students only)

name: St. Joe's Cafe
description: Drop-in breakfast (50¢) and lunch ($1), plus clothing, bread and pet food when available.
eligibility: Drop in. Children must be with an adult.
address: 602 Queens Ave, Unit 101, London, ON N6B 1Y8
hours: Mon–Fri 9:30–11 am and 12–1:30 pm; Sat and holidays 11 am–12:45 pm

name: Ark Aid Street Mission
description: Free drop-in meals, plus counselling, clothing, hygiene supplies, and help with housing and jobs.
eligibility: People facing poverty, homelessness or other barriers.

name: Western USC Food Support Services
description: Free on-campus food bank. Take what you need, or ask about the confidential hamper service.
address: University Community Centre, Room 40F, 1151 Richmond St, London, ON N6A 3K7

name: Salvation Army Centre of Hope
description: Emergency shelter that's open around the clock, with transitional housing, withdrawal management and a recovery community centre.
eligibility: People experiencing or at risk of homelessness. Call or visit for intake.

name: Men's Mission (Mission Services of London)
description: 111-bed emergency shelter for men, with meals, clothing, hygiene supplies, medical support and help finding housing.
eligibility: Men 16 and older experiencing homelessness. No referral needed.

name: Unity Project
description: Emergency shelter with beds, meals and housing support for adults of all genders, with space for couples, pets and people with medical conditions.
eligibility: Adults 18+. Admission is by referral from the City of London Coordinated Access team: 519-661-4663.

name: London InterCommunity Health Centre
description: Free primary health care and community programs for people who face barriers to care.
eligibility: Varies by program. Serves people with low incomes, newcomers and people with complex health needs.
hours: Clinic Mon, Tue, Thu 9 am–4 pm; Wed 9 am–6 pm; Fri 9 am–12 pm

name: Middlesex-London Health Unit
description: Public health services, including vaccinations, sexual health, dental health and prenatal programs. Most programs are free.
address: 355 Wellington St, Suite 110 (Citi Plaza), London, ON N6A 3N7

name: Southwest Ontario Aboriginal Health Access Centre (SOAHAC)
description: Free health care that brings together traditional healing and Western medicine.

name: CMHA Thames Valley Crisis Centre
description: Mental health and addictions crisis support, assessment and crisis response, available day and night.
eligibility: People experiencing a mental health or addictions crisis.

name: Family Service Thames Valley
description: One-on-one, family and group counselling, including single-session counselling. Fees are on a sliding scale.
eligibility: Single-session counselling is for people 16 and older.
address: 500 South St, Suite 2, London, ON N6B 1C3
hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 9 am–8 pm; Wed 9 am–5 pm; Fri 9 am–4 pm

name: London Public Library: Central Library
description: Free Wi-Fi, computers, study space and programs for all ages. Get two hours of free parking at Citi Plaza with a voucher from the main desk.
hours: Mon–Thu 9 am–9 pm; Fri 9 am–6 pm; Sat 9 am–5 pm; Sun closed

name: London Public Library: Crouch Library
description: Neighbourhood library in east London with free Wi-Fi, computers and programs.
hours: Tue–Thu 9 am–9 pm; Fri 10 am–6 pm; Sat 9 am–5 pm; Sun–Mon closed

name: London Public Library: Masonville Library
description: Library near Western University with free Wi-Fi, computers and study space.
address: 30 North Centre Rd, London, ON N5X 3W1
hours: Tue–Thu 9 am–9 pm; Fri 10 am–6 pm; Sat 9 am–5 pm; Sun–Mon closed

name: London Cross Cultural Learner Centre
description: Settlement help for newcomers and refugees, including housing, jobs, school, language assessment, interpretation and community connections. Services in English and many other languages.

name: Youth Action Centre (Youth Opportunities Unlimited)
description: Drop-in with bagged lunches, hot dinners, an emergency food bank, laundry, showers, hygiene and baby supplies, and help finding housing.
eligibility: Youth 16–24 experiencing or at risk of homelessness.
